name: VNDC
oneLiner: VNDC is Jade Labs's Vietnamese dong stablecoin redeemable 1:1 via ONUS and VNDC Hub, with self-reported reserves and no third-party attestation.
collateral: Vietnamese dong reserves self-reported by Jade Labs (the VNDC issuer) and tracked across Polygon and BNB Smart Chain deployments; no formal independent attestation is published
pegMechanism: 1:1 fiat-collateralized issuer mint and redemption operated by Jade Labs through the ONUS and VNDC Hub platforms with VND on/off-ramps via Vietnamese banking partners; reserve backing is self-reported by Jade Labs with no third-party attestation, audit cadence, or proof-of-reserves feed currently published

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: centralized issuer with discretionary mint/redeem authority; contract source not independently audited and ONUS deployment retains administrative pause and reissue privileges.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Pharos lane D Wave 3 non-USD review

notices.title: Market cap and supply inconsistency
notices.message: Aggregator-reported market cap (~$50M) does not consistently match on-chain Polygon/BSC supply, and reserves are self-disclosed by Jade Labs without an independent audit cadence.

notices.title: Curated reserves are self-reported
notices.message: The curated-validated live-reserves adapter points at the Jade Labs / VNDC issuer website because no third-party attestation page has been verified. Reserve composition reflects the issuer's own disclosure only until an independent auditor or proof-of-reserves feed is published.

mintAuthority.summary: VNDC is issued by Jade Labs (Singapore) and operated through the ONUS/VNDC Hub platforms; minting and redemption run through an issuer-controlled, admin-gated token with no third-party audit and no permissionless mint route.

controls.label: Jade Labs / VNDC issuer admin (owner-controlled issue/redeem)
controls.evidence: VNDC contracts are Tether-style centralized tokens; BSC owner() returned this EOA and cast code returned 0x, so the issuer admin can authorize owner-controlled supply operations against self-reported VND reserves.

review.evidence: VNDC is a 1:1 VND-pegged token developed by Jade Labs and tied to the ONUS ecosystem; its on-chain contracts use owner-controlled issue/burn and an admin map with whitelists, confirming a centralized issuer mint with no third-party audit cadence published.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism confirmed from explorer contract structure (Tether-style owner-controlled issue/burn plus admin map), issuer materials, and live BSC owner() read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve which exact EOA/multisig holds the contract owner and admin-map privileges across the Polygon and BSC deployments.
